name: AnimTrigger_ParseConfigFile
note: Name from igi.exe error string INSIDE this function: "AnimTrigger_ParseConfigFile(): Couldn't load script: %s" @0x54DB98. Parses an animtrigger config file into trigger entries.

name: Qvm_Cleanup
note: Frees a loaded QVM script object: reads qvm+0x8C and releases the program block when non-zero. Param: qvm = pointer from Qvm_Load. Pair with Qvm_Load to avoid leaks.

name: Config_Compile
signature: int Config_Compile(int context, char* cfgName, int flags)
note: Compiles a CONFIG script: validates context, then loads its compiled QVM via QvmLoad (0x4B80B0); references the Task_New name during task-table wiring. Params: context = config context id, cfgName = config path/name, flags = compile flags. Use when (re)loading game configuration programmatically.

name: Config_Read
note: Read game config file, Params:  File: 'LOCAL:config.qsc'

name: Config_Write
note: Write game config file, Params: File: 'LOCAL:config.qsc'

name: Game_CutsceneDelete
note: Deletes/ends the running cutscene and frees its resources. Takes no args. | OUTRO USAGE: each level OBJECTS.QVM ends with a ConditionalContainer Task_New named "Outro cutscene" (condition e.g. "AreaActivate_156.nActive && !HumanPlayer_0.isDead") that calls MenuManager_SetEnabled(FALSE)+Game_DisableMusic()+THIS FUNCTION before playing the exit CutScene (e.g. CutScene_2222 heli escape), then restores menus/music on finish. TO REMOVE OUTROS: either patch that container condition to FALSE per OBJECTS.QVM, or hook CutScene_TaskUpdate 0x4F51D0 to complete instantly (generic - kills intro+outro in all levels). LEVEL4 example verified via OpenIGI QvmDisasm.

name: Error_Show
note: Shows a fatal-error dialog: printf-style FORMAT STRING + variadic args (e.g. push "Level_Load(): Couldn't load script: %s"; push scriptPath; call). Param: format = printf-style string, followed by substitution args. Variadic - proven by retail call sites (add esp,8 cleanup) and vsprintf helper fcn.004A5702.

name: Frames_Set
note: Set game frames, Params: 30,60 max 240FPS.

name: GameMaterial_LoadParameters
note: Name from igi.exe error string inside function: "GameMaterial_LoadParameters: Couldn't load script \"%s\"". Loads game-material parameters from its script.

name: Config_ResetGraphicOptions
note: Resets graphic options to FACTORY DEFAULTS - machine-verified field writes: width=0x280 (640), height=0x1E0 (480), plus clearing adjacent flag bytes on the profile record. Takes no script args. Registered by igi.exe as "Config_ResetGraphicOptions" (site 0x40352B) and called by retail MAINMENU.QVM. Use to restore 640x480 defaults programmatically.

name: Graph_Open
note: Open graph of level,Params: with str 'Graph4019.dat'

name: HumanPlayer_LoadParameters
note: Name from igi.exe error string inside function: "HumanPlayer_LoadParameters: Couldn't load script \"%s\"". Loads humanplayer parameters (weapons/ammo/cycle definitions) from script.

name: Game_DisablePlayerInput
note: Disables ALL player input (keyboard+mouse) - used by cutscenes/menus. Re-enable with Game_EnablePlayerInput.

name: Game_EnablePlayerInput
note: Re-enables player input after Game_DisablePlayerInput. Takes no args.

name: Log_Add
note: Appends a formatted line to the engine log (variadic printf-style, giant 0x400 format buffer at esp+0x404). Only logs when log-enabled globals 0xA43EC8/0xA43ED4 are set. Param: format = printf-style string + substitution args. Gate your spammy logs behind the enable flags.

name: Level_LoadObjects
note: Loads all OBJECTS for the level: reads the level object set and instantiates each object entity in the world. Takes the level/path argument from the calling load script. Use during level-load flow before Level_Start. [Name corrected per retail analysis: was LevelLoad/LevelQuit/LevelRestart.]

name: Game_DeleteHandler
note: The game's DELETE handler - runs when a level/game session is torn down (quit path), releasing entities and session state. Takes no args. Engine-internal teardown; do not call to 'quit' - it is the cleanup callback. [Name corrected per retail analysis: was LevelLoad/LevelQuit/LevelRestart.]

name: Game_Restart
note: Restarts the CURRENT LEVEL/session: tears down and reloads the running game state (the Ctrl+F4-style restart path). Takes no args. Use to reset the mission without going back to menus. [Name corrected per retail analysis: was LevelLoad/LevelQuit/LevelRestart.]

name: Level_Start
note: Start new level, Params:  p1: 0057BABC

name: Menu_Manager
signature: int* Menu_Manager(int p1,char *menu_str,char p3,char p4,int p5)
note: MenuManager load for inagame or Mainmenu,Params:  p1: 0057BABC ,p3,p4,p5: 0.

name: Game_DisableMusic
note: Stops the music engine. Takes no args.

name: Game_EnableMusic
note: Starts/resumes the music engine. Takes no args.

name: Music_SetSfxVolume
note: Sets the SFX bus volume feeding the music/sound mix path. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0 scaled by global factor. Use for live SFX fade.

name: Music_SetVolume
note: Sets BOTH music engine volumes (likely front/master pair) after scaling by the global music factor. Params: volume1, volume2 = floats 0.0-1.0 scaled against settings. Use for live music fades.

name: Game_UpdateVolume
note: Applies current profile music/sfx volumes to the live audio engines. Takes no args.

name: PhysicsObjType_ParseConfigFile
note: Name from igi.exe error string inside function: "PhysicsObjType_ParseConfigFile(): Couldn't load script" @0x54DC7C. Parses a physicsobj type config.

name: Qhash_Init
note: Init hash table value, Params: hash value 0 or 1.

name: Qhash_Reset
note: Reset QTask type hash table.

name: Qsc_Compile
note: Compiles a .qsc SCRIPT SOURCE into a .qvm binary: resolves the path (fcn_004B5B60), pulls the source through ResourceLoad (0x4B5F00), allocates a 0x94-byte compiler context via Mem_Alloc, emits ".qvm" output. Param: qscPath = script source path. RETURNS result object/flag.

name: Qtask_Update
note: Update QTask hash table call before loading level.

name: Qtask_UpdateList
note: Update all QTask list, Params: p1 ??

name: QScript_Assemble
note: ASSEMBLER stage of the script pipeline: strips comments via regex "{.*:(.*//)*}.*", initialises the parser ("Initialising parser."), generates assembly code and WRITES IT TO "LOCAL:qvmbin.tmp" (also referenced as /0qvmbin.tmp). Params: srcText = script source buffer, srcLen2 = secondary length/context arg. Returns assembly result.

name: Qvm_Execute
note: EXECUTES a loaded QVM script program (the interpreter entry - despite the old analyst label QvmRead). On runtime failure reports "Error in QVM program: %s" / "An error occured in script file: %s". Param: qvm = pointer from Qvm_Load. RETURNS script result value.

name: Qvm_Load
note: Loads a COMPILED .qvm script binary from the virtual filesystem (appends/selects ".qvm"; big 0x130 stack frame builds the script object). Param: qvmPath = path like "LOCAL:common/ai/guard.qvm". RETURNS pointer to the loaded QVM object, 0 on failure (calls engine debug-state check 0x48F1D0 first). Use before executing/attaching scripts.

name: QScript_ParseAndAssemble
note: PARSE+CODEGEN driver: logs "Parsing script and generating assembly code.", runs parser state globals (0xA442D0..), writes output ("Failed to open file '%s' for writing."). Params: srcText = script source, options = parser option word. Part of the QscCompile pipeline feeding QScript_Assemble.

name: Resource_Flush
note: Flushes/finalizes ONE resource entry: walks the global resource list (0x943E38), matches entry+0x34 against the argument, errors "Resource_Flush() : Couldn't locate resource at %p." when absent. Param: resEntry = resource pointer/address to flush.

name: Resource_Load
note: Loads a resource into memory WITH CACHE CHECK: first asks IsResourceLoaded (0x4B5B90); if cached returns the existing entry, otherwise loads and registers it. Params: resourcePath = virtual resource path, outBuffer = receives the data pointer. RETURNS resource entry pointer.

name: Resource_Unload
note: Name from igi.exe error string inside function: "Resource_Unload() : Resource '%s' is not loaded." Unloads a resource by name/path.

name: Is_ResourceLoaded
note: Checks whether a resource path is ALREADY LOADED in the resource manager (walks path handling backslash 0x5C segments against the registry). Params: resourcePath = virtual path, outEntry = receives matching entry. RETURNS non-zero + fills outEntry when found. Resource_Load calls this first - use it to avoid double-loading.

name: Resource_PackUnpack
note: Opens a PACKED resource file via QFile_ReadWrite (0x4B1510, mode string at 0x53B604) and unpacks its contents through the pack table at 0x9436E8. Params: resFile = packed resource path, outBuffer = receives unpacked data. RETURNS entry/result pointer.

name: Resource_Unpack
signature: int Resource_Unpack(int* resPtr, int destAddr, int resSize)
note: Unpacks a loaded resource blob to a destination address. Params: resPtr = packed resource pointer, destAddr = destination memory address, resSize = bytes to unpack. RETURNS unpacked size/status.

name: Script_Init
signature: void Script_Init(char* file_name,int8_t p2,int p3,int8_t p4)
note: Initialises the script system for a file. Params: file_name = script path, p2 = byte flag (observed), p3 = int option, p4 = byte flag. Refined types from decompiled header (two int8_t slots detected).

name: Script_SetSymbolContext
note: Name from igi.exe error string inside function: "Script_SetSymbolContext(): Symbol not found: %s". Sets the symbol context for subsequent script operations.

name: StatusMessageScreen_ClearMessages
note: Clears all on-screen status messages. Takes no args.

name: StatusMessage_ShowFull
signature: void StatusMessage_ShowFull(int timer, char* message, char* sprite, int styleByte)
note: Full-parameter status message: queues an on-screen HUD message with icon and styling (allocates via Mem_Alloc, reads current status word 0x540A8C). Params: timer = display duration, message = text, sprite = HUD sprite/icon ptr, styleByte = display style byte. Use MISC::STATUS_MESSAGE_SHOW wrapper for simple cases.

name: Symbol_Remove
note: Removes a symbol from the game-data symbol hash table; warns "Unable to remove symbol \"%s\" (not registered)" when absent. Params: symTable = symbol table, symName = symbol name string. RETURNS non-zero on success. Call after dynamically registered symbols are no longer needed.

name: TaskType_Set
note: Stores the TYPE ID onto a task definition structure (simple field write, verified 2-arg store). Params: taskDef = task definition object, taskTypeId = TASKTYPE_* enum value (TASKTYPE_GUN, TASKTYPE_BUILDING, etc. - full enum embedded in igi.exe .data).

name: Warning_Show
note: Shows a warning dialog - printf-style variadic like ErrorShow (retail: push str."QTasktype \"%s\"..."; push eax; call -> add esp,8). Param: format = printf-style string + substitution args.

name: Weapon_ConfigRead
note: Reads weapon configuration entries from parsed config text: repeated repne-scasb string scans + block copies populate weapon structures. Params: context = weapon system context, cfgText = config text buffer. Use within weapon definition parsing flows.

name: Symbol_CheckRegister
signature: void* Symbol_CheckRegister(int* symTable, char* symName, int extra)
note: Checks a symbol and registers it if new - ERRORS via ErrorShow("Symbol \"%s\" already registered in hash table") if the name ALREADY exists, so it doubles as duplicate protection. Params: symTable, symName, extra = registration payload/flags. RETURNS symbol entry or triggers the error dialog.

name: Game_DefineOptions
note: Define game options constants , Params: opt_str (int**)'DefineAmmoType'

name: Script_BufInit
signature: void Script_BufInit(int* outBuf1, int buf2, int buf3, int bufSize)
note: Initialises the four header fields of a SCRIPT BUFFER structure (verified field-by-field stores: *out=buf2, then buf3, bufSize...). Params: outBuf1 = buffer struct to init, buf2/buf3 = buffer pointers/ids, bufSize = size field. Call before handing a buffer to the QVM assembler/parsers.

name: Sound_Load
note: Load all level sounds from path , Params: Path of sound like 'MISSION:sounds'

name: Mem_Alloc
note: Engine heap allocator. Params: numBytes = bytes to allocate, tag = allocation bucket shown in the 'Total allocated by user' accounting. RETURNS pointer or 0 on failure (error text: 'Mem_Alloc() failed to allocate %d bytes'). Pair with MemoryDealloc/MemDealloc free path.

name: Mem_DeallocAll
note: Deallocate allocated memory. Frees EVERY tracked heap block (walks allocation list via 0x4B0D10), then warns "%d block(s) of memory have not been deallocated." Takes no args - NOT a single-pointer free.

name: Mission_Open
note: Name from igi.exe error string inside function: "Mission_Open(): Couldn't load script: %s". Opens a mission definition script and builds its task tree.

name: File_Open
note: Low-level CRT-style file open used across the engine. Params: path = file path, mode = fopen-style mode string ("r","w","rb"...). RETURNS FILE* handle or 0. Prefer QFile_ReadWrite/QResource APIs unless you need raw stdio.

name: QFile_ReadWrite
note: VIRTUAL-filesystem open: parses the device prefix from vpath (errors "Illegal device name in path: \" and "Device not present: %s"), routes to the device handler chain (0x4B1620/0x4B1020/0x4B11A0) and returns a Q-file handle. Params: vpath = virtual path WITH device prefix (e.g. "LOCAL:...", "MENU:"), mode = access mode. RETURNS handle or 0. This is the correct opener for LOCAL:/MISSION: paths.

name: Rigid_DyncubeObjRead
note: Read rigid dynCube config file , Params: config file of rigid dynCube.

name: Magic_ObjLoad
note: Loads magic objects from path, Params: Path 'LOCAL:magicobj'

name: Anim_TriggerLoad
note: Loads anim trigger objects from path, Params: Path 'LOCAL:animtrigger'

name: Physics_ObjLoad
note: Loads physics objects from path, Params: Path 'LOCAL:physicsobj'

name: Ammo_TypeOpen
note: Open ammo qvm file to memory for all weapons loaded.

name: Weapon_TypeOpen
note: Open all weapons defined in .qsc file for Humanplayer.

name: Game_DataSymbolLoad
signature: int Game_DataSymbolLoad(char* symBuf, char* symPath, char* symName)
note: Parses game-data SYMBOL DEFINITIONS from a buffer into the symbol table: tokenizes via 0x4A7720 with per-name limit 0x42 (66 bytes) and count cap 0x7FFFFFFF, null-terminates each parsed name. Params: symBuf = symbol buffer base, symPath = source path ref, symName = initial name entry. RETURNS parse status. Feeds the table that Symbol_Register*/GameData_SymbolRemove operate on.

name: Game_DataSymbolRemoveThunk
note: Thin remover for the game-data symbol table: forwards its single argument down the removal chain (verified pure thunk returning eax). Param: symBuf = symbol/buffer to unregister. Prefer this over direct internal calls.

name: SymbolRegister_Bool8
note: Registers a BOOL8-TYPED script variable slot in the game-data symbol table (2-arg typed thunk family; each sibling hardcodes its type size). Params: table = symbol table, name = variable name. RETURNS the registered symbol entry. Script code can then read/write it as a bool.

name: SymbolRegister_Int16
note: Registers an INT16-typed script variable slot. Params: table, name. RETURNS symbol entry. Sibling of SymbolRegister_Bool8/Int32/Real32 - same thunk shape, different type tag.

name: SymbolRegister_Int32
note: Registers an INT32-typed script variable slot. Params: table, name. RETURNS symbol entry. This is the common integer script-variable registration used by AI/game scripts.

name: SymbolRegister_Real32
note: Registers a REAL32 (float)-typed script variable slot. Params: table, name. RETURNS symbol entry. Pairs with AIFunction_Set/GetScriptRealValue for float storage.

name: LoadingScreen_Show
note: Shows the LOADING SCREEN: allocates a 0x1C-byte screen object, queries the active display mode (0x491CF0), and loads "LOCAL:menusystem/loadingscreen.res" with picture "LOCAL:menusystem/loading.pic" - or "loading_us.pic" for USA country builds. Param: picVariant = loading-screen type selector. Call before long loads so the player sees feedback.

name: Q_TaskHashTableSet
signature: void Q_TaskHashTableSet(int** table, void* handler, int nameVal, int p4, int p5, int p6, int p7)
note: THE CORE REGISTRAR: inserts an entry into the task/hash table binding a name-value pair to a handler callback. All 7 stack args confirmed by disassembly header (arg_18h..arg_3Ch). Every SymbolRegister* thunk (e.g. 0x4B7EE0 pushes 1,1,0,1,addr,handler,table -> this) and every GAME_DEFINE_OPTIONS registration routes here. Params: table = target hash table, handler = callback invoked for the symbol, nameVal = name/value ref, p4-p7 = type/flag slots (see SymbolRegister thunks for known values).

name: Weapons_CountGet
note: RETURNS the number of weapons defined for the human player: reads global counter 0x57B18C (exactly `mov eax,[0x57B18C]; ret`). That counter is written by the DefineHumanPlayerWeaponCycle definition parser - so this reflects the current weapon-cycle list length. Use to bounds-check weapon indexes before Weapon_GunPickup-style calls.

name: Weapon_GunPickup
note: Gives a GUN pickup to the player: checks the player's already-carried flag (player+0xCF5), reads the weapon id from pickupEntity+8 -> word +0x1C, validates the weapon category via 0x401CF0, hands the weapon over (0x477BF0/0x477C50) and plays the 'weaponpickup_1' sound (0x47CE00/0x4E7200). Params: player = player/Human struct ptr, pickupEntity = the picked-up world entity. Use for custom weapon pickups.

name: Weapon_AmmoPickup
note: Gives an AMMO pickup to the player (same struct conventions as Weapon_GunPickup: player carry-flags and pickup-entity fields drive the grant; plays the pickup sound). Params: player = player struct ptr, pickupEntity = ammo world entity. Use for custom ammo pickups.

name: Human_HitDamage
note: Reads the player XP/hit byte: returns byte [PlayerPtr+0xE1]. Takes no args. Documented alias of HUMAN_HIT_DAMAGE - same address.

name: Human_ViewCam
note: Sets the human's VIEW-CAMERA selector: stores camValue into human struct offset +0x4F0 (verified: mov [ecx+0x4F0],eax; ret - 5-byte setter). Params: human = Human/soldier struct ptr, camValue = camera mode index. Use to switch a soldier's view/camera state directly.

name: Human_TaskViewReset
note: Resets the human's VIEW TANGENT fields to retail defaults: computes tan() of the half-FOV globals 0x5335E8/0x5339C0 (the same globals ENHANCER::FOV_SET writes) and stores them into human+0x1E4 and human+0x1E8, clearing human+0x1EC. Param: human = Human/soldier struct ptr. This is THE retail restore path - call after custom FOV/binocular zoom to return to normal view.

name: Config_GetActivePlayerProfileRecord
note: RETURNS pointer to the ACTIVE PROFILE's graphic-options/config record: computed as 0xBC2388 + 0xD14*[0xBC2384] (verified against retail defaults-reset fcn.00403B70 which walks the same layout). Takes no args. Despite the historical name this returns a record pointer, not a bool. Old analyst name IsPlayerProfileActive was wrong - it returns the record pointer, not a bool.

name: Soldier_Execute
note: Executes/initializes a SOLDIER AI entity in the level. Params: context = task/context object (2nd arg is the soldier ptr - verified: esi=[esp+0x1C] after prologue). The function reads soldier-struct fields +0x800 (ptr), +0x4C4 and +0x254 (sub-object bases passed to spawner 0x4F2060), +0xD1C, then installs a per-soldier callback (0x45C700) into the created object at +0x14 and routes through 0x48A330. Referenced via soldier-task VTABLE at .data 0x53EC90 (not called directly). SOLDIER STRUCT LAYOUT (recovered from the 0x45C190-0x45CA50 vtable family): +0x68 name/string area; +0x254 patrol/waypoint sub-struct (field +0x94 used); +0x2EC param ptr slot; +0x33D flag byte; +0x4C4 object ref; +0x696 active/enable flag (0=off, 1=on); +0x800 ptr; +0xD0C id (0xFFFFFFFF = unset); +0xD14 dword; +0xD1C ptr. Sibling vtable methods: 0x45C190, 0x45C1C0, 0x45C2E0, 0x45C330, 0x45C5A0, 0x45C650, 0x45C750, 0x45C8B0, 0x45CA50 (same struct, enable/disable/reset semantics).

name: Flow_RequestEvent
note: Requests a flow-task event by id (drives the level's flow state machine). Param: eventId = flow event number used in the level flow script. Use from mission flow scripts to trigger scripted transitions. FLOW_EVENT enum: None=0, QUIT=1, INTRO=2, MAINMENU=3, GAME=4, RESTART_GAME=5 (events 6-8 exist internally but have no registered constants).

name: GO_Player
note: Adds a player profile named 'name' to the config while a .cfg/GO script block is being read; subsequent GO_* settings apply to this profile. Param: name = profile display name (string). Use inside config/profile scripts, must come before that profile's GO_* settings. Returns 1.

name: GO_InRemap
signature: int GO_InRemap(int key1, int key2, int action)
note: Adds one input binding (key remap) to the current profile. Params: key1 = primary key code, key2 = secondary key code, action = in-game action id being bound. Use in input/config scripts, repeat once per binding. Returns 1.

name: GO_InMouInv
note: Toggles inverted mouse-look for the current profile. Param: invert = 1 invert Y axis, 0 normal. Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

name: GO_InMouSens
note: Sets mouse sensitivity for the current profile. Param: sensitivity = float multiplier as saved by the options screen. Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

name: GO_GfxDisp
note: Sets display-mode selection for the current profile. Param: displayMode = mode index from the retail display list (see Display_GetActiveMode/display table). Use in config scripts. igi.exe registers it with argc=3 at its site; the extra args go unused by the setter itself.

name: GO_GfxDevice
note: Sets render-device (D3D device/GUID) selection for the current profile. Param: deviceIndex = index into the render-device list filled by Config_FillRenderDeviceListBox. Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

name: GO_GfxGamma
note: Sets gamma for the current profile. Param: gamma = float, retail default 1.0 (range ~0.5-3.0 clamped elsewhere). Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

name: GO_GameLang
note: Sets game language for the current profile. Param: language = language index (retail ships English=0 and German builds use their own index). Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

name: GO_GameDiff
note: Sets game difficulty for the current profile. Param: difficulty = 0 easy, 1 medium, 2 hard (retail order). Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

name: GO_IsBlood
note: Toggles blood effects for the current profile. Param: blood = 1 on, 0 off. Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

name: GO_SoundSpeech
note: Sets speech volume for the current profile. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0. Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

name: GO_SoundMusic
note: Sets music volume for the current profile. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0. Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

name: GO_SoundFX
note: Sets sound-effects volume for the current profile. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0. Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

name: GO_GfxPerformance
note: Sets graphics performance/detail flags for the current profile. Param: flags = bitmask from the detail-level mapping (see Config_GraphicOptionsGetPerfFlagsFromLevel). Use in config scripts. Returns 1.

name: GO_ActiveMission
note: Sets the active (last-played) mission number for the current player profile. Param: mission = mission index 1..14. Use in profile/config scripts after GO_Player. Returns 1.

name: GO_ContentControlPW
note: Config-writer form (argc=1): sets the content-control password while a config file is parsed. Param: password = string. Returns 1.

name: Config_FillPlayerProfileListBox
note: Fills the current menu list box with all player profiles (name per row, row index = profile index). Use inside the profile-selection list box collect-items script.

name: Config_GetActivePlayerProfileIndex
note: RETURNS the index of the currently-active player profile (0-based). Takes no arguments. Use whenever you need which profile is selected, e.g. before Config_DeletePlayerProfile.

name: Config_SetActivePlayerProfileIndex
note: Makes 'index' the active player profile. Param: index = 0-based profile index (must exist; see Config_GetNumberOfPlayerProfiles).

name: Config_CreateNewPlayerProfile
note: Creates a new player profile. Params: name = new profile name (string), sourceIndex = existing profile index to copy initial settings from. RETURNS 1 on success, 0 on failure (e.g. name taken/slots full). Use on the create-profile screen.

name: Config_DeletePlayerProfile
note: Deletes a player profile. Param: index = 0-based profile index to delete. RETURNS 1 on success, 0 on failure. Do not delete the last remaining profile; refresh your list box afterwards.

name: Config_PlayerGetActiveMission
note: Returns the active (reached) mission number of ANY profile. Param: profileIndex = 0-based profile index. Use on the profile/mission screens to show progress without switching profiles.

name: Config_GetNumberOfPlayerProfiles
note: RETURNS how many player profiles exist. Use to bounds-check indexes and to size profile lists.

name: Config_FillMissionSelectionBox
note: Fills the current menu list box with missions selectable for the active profile (respects unlocked progress). Use inside the mission-selection list box collect-items script.

name: Config_FillMissionPictureBox
note: Fills the current picture box with the selected mission's briefing image. Use inside the mission-picture control's script right after a mission row is chosen.

name: Config_FillMissionTextBox
note: Fills the current text box with the selected mission's briefing text. Use inside the mission-briefing text control's script.

name: Config_FillScreenResolutionListBox
note: Fills the currently-active menu list box with the screen resolutions available for a device. Param: deviceIndex = render-device index. Use only inside a menu list box 'collect items' script so the items land in that control.

name: Config_FillRenderDeviceListBox
note: Fills the currently-active menu list box with installed render devices (Direct3D device GUIDs/names). Use inside a list box collect-items script on the video-options screen.

name: Config_GameOptionsInputGetInvertMouse
note: RETURNS the invert-mouse setting when the engine writes/reads a config game-options block (1 = inverted, 0 = normal). Takes no args. Pairs with Config_GameOptionsInputSetInvertMouse.

name: Config_GameOptionsInputGetMouseSensitivity
note: RETURNS the stored mouse-sensitivity integer from the game-options config context. Takes no args.

name: Config_GameOptionsInputGetBloodEnabled
note: RETURNS the blood-enabled flag from the game-options config context (1/0). Takes no args.

name: Config_GameOptionsInputSetInvertMouse
note: Sets invert-mouse in the GAME-OPTIONS block while a config file is parsed (the GO_* writer side; runtime getter/setter pair lives on the profile). Param: invert = 1 inverted, 0 normal. Use only inside config .qsc write-out contexts.

name: Config_GameOptionsInputSetMouseSensitivity
note: Sets mouse-sensitivity in the config game-options write-out context. Param: value = sensitivity as stored by the options screen (integer scale).

name: Config_GameOptionsInputSetBloodEnabled
note: Sets blood-enabled in the config game-options write-out context. Param: blood = 1 on, 0 off.

name: Config_GraphicOptionsSetResolution
note: Applies a screen resolution to the active profile and re-initialises the display. Param: modeIndex = index from Config_FillScreenResolutionListBox entries. Use in the video-options screen script.

name: Config_GraphicOptionsSetTransparency
note: Toggles transparency for the active profile. Param: onOff = 1 enable, 0 disable. Video-options screen.

name: Config_GraphicOptionsSetDevice
note: Applies a render device to the active profile. Param: deviceIndex = index from Config_FillRenderDeviceListBox. Use in video-options screen script.

name: Config_GraphicOptionsSetPerformanceFlags
note: Sets the raw graphics performance/detail flag bits on the active profile. Param: flags = bitmask (get a valid one from Config_GraphicOptionsGetPerfFlagsFromLevel).

name: Config_GraphicOptionsGetResolution
note: Returns the active profile's display-mode/resolution index (same index space as Config_GraphicOptionsSetResolution). Use in video-options UI scripts to preselect the current value.

name: Config_GraphicOptionsGetTransparency
note: Returns 1 if transparency is enabled for the active profile, else 0.

name: Config_GraphicOptionsGetDevice
note: Returns the active profile's render-device index (index into the device list). Use in video-options UI scripts.

name: Config_GraphicOptionsGetGamma
note: Returns the active profile's gamma as a float. Use to initialise your own gamma slider/UI.

name: Config_GraphicOptionsGetPerformanceFlags
note: Returns the active profile's graphics performance flag bitmask.

name: Config_GraphicOptionsGetPerfFlagsFromLevel
note: Converts a detail LEVEL number into its performance-flag bitmask. Param: level = 0..Config_GraphicOptionsNumPerfLevels()-1. Use when the user picks a named detail preset.

name: Config_GraphicOptionsGetPerfLevelFromFlags
note: Converts a performance-flag bitmask back into its detail LEVEL number. Param: flags = bitmask from the profile/performance setting. Use to show the current detail level in UI.

name: Config_GraphicOptionsNumPerfLevels
note: RETURNS the number of graphics detail levels the engine supports (constant). Use to build the detail-level slider/list.

name: Config_SoundOptionsSetSoundsEffects
note: Enables/disables sound effects for the active profile. Param: onOff = 1 on, 0 off.

name: Config_SoundOptionsSetSoundsEffectsVolume
note: Sets SFX volume for the active profile. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0.

name: Config_SoundOptionsSetMusic
note: Enables/disables music for the active profile. Param: onOff = 1 on, 0 off.

name: Config_SoundOptionsSetMusicVolume
note: Sets music volume for the active profile. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0 (pops a float arg - pass a float!).

name: Config_SoundOptionsSetSpeech
note: Enables/disables radio speech for the active profile. Param: onOff = 1 on, 0 off.

name: Config_SoundOptionsSetSpeechVolume
note: Sets speech volume for the active profile. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0.

name: Config_SoundOptionsSetReverseStereo
note: Toggles reversed stereo channels for the active profile. Param: onOff = 1 reverse, 0 normal.

name: Config_SoundOptionsGetSoundsEffects
note: Returns 1 if sound effects are enabled for the active profile, else 0.

name: Config_SoundOptionsGetSoundsEffectsVolume
note: Returns the active profile's SFX volume (0.0-1.0).

name: Config_SoundOptionsGetMusic
note: Returns 1 if music is enabled for the active profile, else 0.

name: Config_SoundOptionsGetMusicVolume
note: Returns the active profile's music volume (0.0-1.0).

name: Config_SoundOptionsGetSpeech
note: Returns 1 if speech is enabled for the active profile, else 0.

name: Config_SoundOptionsGetSpeechVolume
note: Returns the active profile's speech volume (0.0-1.0).

name: Config_SoundOptionsGetReverseStereo
note: Returns 1 if stereo is reversed for the active profile, else 0.

name: Config_SetContentControlPassword
note: Menu-script setter form (argc=0): same address registered twice by igi.exe - site 0x4034C1 pushes str "Config_SetContentControlPassword" -> registrar 0x4B8890. Password comes from the script context, not an explicit arg. Returns 1.

name: Config_GetContentControlPassword
note: RETURNS the stored content-control (parental lock) password string. Takes no args. Compare against user input or pass to Config_VerifyContentControlPassword.

name: Config_VerifyContentControlPassword
note: Checks a password attempt against the stored content-control password. Param: password = string to test. RETURNS non-zero when correct, 0 when wrong. Use before unlocking violent-content options.

name: Config_IsContentControlPasswordEnabled
note: RETURNS 1 if a content-control password is SET (parental lock active), else 0. Takes no args. Use to decide whether to ask for the password.

name: Config_IsGermany
note: RETURNS 1 when running the GERMAN retail build (censored variant), 0 otherwise. Takes no args. German builds gate blood/gore - check before forcing such effects.

name: DefineQ_Material
note: Defines a Q-material (surface material) entry while a material definition block is parsed. Called BY the engine's own define-block parser - call only from material .qsc definition contexts; arg layout follows the Define block grammar (registration argc unknown).

name: Define_GameMaterial
note: Defines a GameMaterial entry during a game-material definition block (855-byte parser function). Call only from gamematerial .qsc definition contexts; arg layout follows the Define block grammar (registration argc unknown).

name: Define_HumanPlayerWeaponCycle
note: Collects the weapon-cycle list for the human player: loops the parsed entries and stores them into the cycle table at 0x56DF1C with count at 0x56DF18 (verified in igi.exe). Call within a humanplayer weapon-cycle definition block; argc unknown (parser context).

name: Define_HumanPlayerWeaponCategory
note: Registers one weapon-category entry for the human player during a humanplayer definition block (argc unknown - parser context). Pairs with DefineHumanPlayerWeaponCycle/Cycle ordering.

name: Define_HumanPlayerAmmoLimit
note: Registers an ammo-limit entry (max carried ammo class) for the human player during a humanplayer definition block (argc unknown - parser context).

name: MovieSubtitle_RegisterFont
note: Registers a font used by in-game movie subtitles (16 callsites in body; argc unknown - parser context). Call from subtitle/font definition blocks before any MovieSubtitle_RegisterText that uses it.

name: MovieSubtitle_RegisterText
note: Registers one subtitle text entry (string + timing) shown over movies/briefings (argc unknown - parser context). Call after the font registration it should use.

name: Game_SetMission
note: Selects the mission the game will run/load next. Param: mission = mission index 1..14. Use before Level_Start/level load flow when jumping straight into a mission.

name: Game_SetMusicVolume
note: Live-sets music volume through the profile real-value setter (fcn.004B8A50): retail body constructs 1.0f (0x3FF00000) and stores via fstp. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0. Called by ingamemenu.qvm options sliders.

name: Game_SetSFXVolume
note: Live-sets sound-effects volume through the profile real-value setter (fcn.004B8A50), same 1.0f construction pattern. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0. Called by ingamemenu.qvm options sliders.

name: MenuManager_RequestScreen
note: Requests a menu screen by id through the menu manager (queued request). Params: screenId = retail screen resource id, flags = request modifier (0 = normal). Use outside the menu stack internals when you just want a screen opened next tick.

name: MenuManager_LeaveMenus
note: Leaves/closes the whole menu system returning to gameplay. Params: two ints observed in retail calls (pass 0,0). Use to exit from custom menus.

name: MenuManager_SetLanguage
note: Switches menu/UI language at runtime. Param: langIndex = language index matching the LANGUAGE\ folder tables. Call before pushing screens so texts load in the right language.

name: MenuManager_PushScreen
note: Pushes a screen onto the menu stack: allocates the screen object (objsize 0x2898) and stores it in the manager's screen stack at mgr+0x27EC (verified in igi.exe). Param: screenId = retail screen id. Remember to MenuManager_PopScreen when done.

name: MenuManager_PopScreen
note: Pops the top screen off the menu stack (destroys it) revealing the one beneath. Param: param = pass-through argument observed in retail calls (pass 0). Pair with MenuManager_PushScreen.

name: MenuManager_ForceUpdateWindow
note: Forces the menu manager to redraw/update its windows this frame. Param: observed retail value 0. Use after changing control contents from script.

name: MenuManager_ActivatePopupScreen
note: Activates a popup screen on top of the current menus (e.g. confirmation dialogs; retail scripts call MenuManager_ActivatePopupScreen(930)). Param: popupId = retail popup screen id. Use for custom confirmations.

name: MenuManager_DeactivatePopuScreen
note: Deactivates the currently-active popup screen and returns to the screen beneath. Takes no args. Pair with MenuManager_ActivatePopupScreen. NOTE: name mirrors the retail registration string exactly, including its "Popu" typo - do not "fix" it against the binary.

name: MenuManager_SetEnabled
note: Enables/disables menu-manager input processing. Param: enabled = 1 menus react to input, 0 frozen. Use to freeze menus during scripted sequences.

name: ControlsMenu_ConvertFloatFromOffset
note: Converts a controls-menu slider/storage OFFSET into its float value (0.0-1.0 range used by the control configuration bars). Param: offset = raw integer offset stored for that control binding. Use when reading/writing control bindings from script.

name: ControlsMenu_ConvertOffsetFromFloat
note: Inverse of ControlsMenu_ConvertFloatFromOffset: converts a float control value into the raw storage offset. Param: value = float 0.0-1.0. Use when saving a modified binding back.

name: AIAction_Patrol
signature: void AIAction_Patrol(int target, int mustBeZero, int flags)
note: Orders the AI into PATROL behaviour. Params: target = patrol goal/node reference from your script, mustBeZero = retail template always passes 0, flags = AIACTIONFLAG enum: NONE=0, PUSHABLE=1 (action may be replaced by higher priority). Use inside AI event handlers e.g. AIEVENT_IDLE branch. Template in igi.exe: AIAction_Patrol(xxxx, 0, AIACTIONFLAG_NONE).

name: AIAction_Combat
note: Orders the AI into COMBAT behaviour vs its current enemy. Param: param = combat argument from the calling script (retail guard scripts pass their combat target/context value). Use in AIEVENT_COMBAT branches.

name: AIAction_Dead
note: Runs the DEATH handling action for the AI (plays death, releases tasks). Param: param = death context value passed by retail scripts. Use in AIEVENT_DEAD handler.

name: AIAction_FallFlat
note: Knocks the AI flat on the ground (ragdoll-ish fall, e.g. after explosion/surrender). Params: two ints observed in retail calls (pass 0,0 unless mapping specific values). Use for scripted knockdowns.

name: AIAction_Activate
signature: void AIAction_Activate(int target, int param2, int flags)
note: Generic ACTIVATE action: sends the AI to activate/use an object (switch, door, alarm...). Params: target = object/task reference, param2 = secondary value (retail passes 0), flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1). Use in AI handlers for alarm/objective responses.

name: AIAction_WalkToNode
note: Walks the AI to a nav node. Params: nodeId = graph/node id from the level nav data, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1). Use for calm movement in AI scripts.

name: AIAction_RunToNode
note: Runs the AI to a nav node (fast). Same params as AIAction_WalkToNode: nodeId = node id, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1).

name: AIAction_FireAtNode
signature: void AIAction_FireAtNode(int nodeId, int p1, int p2, int p3, int p4)
note: Makes the AI fire AT a nav-node position. Params: nodeId = target node id, remaining 4 args = firing stance/behaviour values observed in retail AI scripts (map before inventing values). Use in combat handlers when target is a position.

name: AIAction_FireAtTask
signature: void AIAction_FireAtTask(int taskId, int p1, int p2, int p3, int p4)
note: Makes the AI fire AT a task/object entity. Params: taskId = target task/entity id, remaining 4 args = firing behaviour values (same layout family as FireAtNode). Use in combat handlers when target is an entity.

name: AIAction_PlayAnimation
note: Plays an animation on the AI. Params: animationId = animation entry id (see AIFunction_AddAnimationEntry), flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1).

name: AIAction_PlaySound
signature: void AIAction_PlaySound(int soundId, int param2, int flags)
note: Plays a sound from the AI (voice barks etc.). Params: soundId = sound/event id, param2 = observed 0 in retail, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1).

name: AIAction_MoveToEvent
note: Moves the AI toward the source position of an EVENT it received. Params: eventId = AIEVENT_* whose position to move to, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1). Use in event handlers (gunshot heard -> move there).

name: AIAction_LookAtEvent
note: Turns the AI to LOOK toward an event's source without moving. Params: eventId = AIEVENT_* value, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1).

name: AIAction_Stunned
note: Stuns the AI (flashbang/knockout reaction). Params: param1 = stun duration/context value, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1).

name: AIAction_KickGrenade
note: Kicks a nearby live grenade away (retail soldier behaviour). Param: param = grenade/context reference from the event. Use in grenade-event handlers.

name: AIAction_RunPanicking
note: Sends the AI into PANIC running (civilians under fire). Params: param1 = panic target/context, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1).

name: AIAction_Idle
note: Puts the AI into IDLE (stands, resumes idle animation countdown). Param: idle context value (retail scripts pass their idle value). Use in AIEVENT_IDLE handler instead of Patrol for stationary guards.

name: AIAction_SetCombat
note: Force-sets the AI's COMBAT ENEMY/target. Param: enemyId = enemy entity/id to engage. Use to make an AI attack a specific target regardless of detection.

name: AIFunction_DefaultHandler
note: The default AI event handler: call this for any AIEVENT_* your script does not handle explicitly (retail template shows it as the else-branch body). Takes no args. Put inside every event if-else chain as fallback.

name: AIFunction_RemoveAlarmActions
note: Removes all queued ALARM-related actions from this AI (calms it down). Takes no args. Use to de-escalate an NPC you control.

name: AIFunction_SetViewLength
note: Sets this AI's VIEW LENGTH - how far it can see. Param: length = view distance in engine units. Use in AI init (AIEVENT_CREATE) to buff/nerf vision.

name: AIFunction_SetAlarmViewLength
note: Sets view length WHILE AN ALARM IS ON (separate stat from normal vision). Param: length = distance in engine units. Use in AI init.

name: AIFunction_SetViewAlpha
note: Sets view ALPHA - the detection speed/gain of normal vision. Param: alpha = engine detection factor. Higher = spots player faster. Use in AIEVENT_CREATE.

name: AIFunction_SetViewGamma
note: Sets view GAMMA - secondary vision shaping factor for detection. Param: gamma = engine factor. Use in AI init alongside SetViewAlpha.

name: AIFunction_SetSecondaryViewLength
note: Sets SECONDARY view length (peripheral/short-range channel). Param: length = distance in engine units.

name: AIFunction_SetSecondaryAlarmViewLength
note: Sets secondary view length during alarms. Param: length = distance in engine units.

name: AIFunction_SetSecondaryViewAlpha
note: Sets secondary-view detection gain. Param: alpha = engine factor.

name: AIFunction_SetSecondaryViewGamma
note: Sets secondary-view gamma shaping factor. Param: gamma = engine factor.

name: AIFunction_SetEventPriority
note: Sets the priority of the CURRENT event being handled (decides which queued event wins). Param: priority = engine priority number. Use inside an event handler.

name: AIFunction_SetInvulnerability
note: Makes this AI invulnerable. Param: onOff = 1 immune to damage, 0 normal. Great for boss/scripted NPCs. Use in AIEVENT_CREATE or anytime.

name: AIFunction_SetInstantDeath
note: When on, any hit instantly kills this AI (no damage pooling). Param: onOff = 1 one-shot kills, 0 normal health. Use for scripted one-shot enemies.

name: AIFunction_SetDeathAnimation
note: Overrides the death animation played when this AI dies. Param: animId = animation entry id. Use in AI init for custom deaths.

name: AIFunction_SetAlarmTriggerID
note: Binds an ALARM trigger object to this AI (which alarm switch it responds to/runs to). Param: id = alarm trigger id from the level. Retail template: AIFunction_SetAlarmTriggerID(xx).

name: AIFunction_SetAlarmControlID
note: Binds the ALARM CONTROL (the raised-alarm device) this AI uses. Param: id = alarm control id from the level. Retail template: AIFunction_SetAlarmControlID(xx).

name: AIFunction_SetAlarmAccess
note: Sets HOW the AI treats the alarm route. Param: access = AIALARMACCESS enum: BEFORECOMBAT=0 (run for the alarm first), AFTERCOMBAT=1 (fight first, raise alarm after). Retail template: AIFunction_SetAlarmAccess(AIALARMACCESS_BEFORECOMBAT).

name: AIFunction_SetGunnerID
note: Assigns which mounted-gunner slot this AI mans. Param: gunnerId = gunner position id. Use in AI init for turret/mounted-gun NPCs.

name: AIFunction_SetScriptIntegerValue
note: Writes an AI-script integer variable. Params: varId = script variable index, value = new integer. Use for custom AI state communication between scripts.

name: AIFunction_SetScriptRealValue
note: Writes an AI-script real (float) variable. Params: varId = script variable index, value = float. Pairs with AIFunction_GetScriptRealValue.

name: AIFunction_SetAnimationInterval
note: Sets playback INTERVAL for an animation entry. Params: entryIndex = animation entry added via AddAnimationEntry, interval = frame/tick interval. Use when tuning scripted animations.

name: AIFunction_AddAnimationEntry
note: Adds an animation ENTRY to this AI's available set (builds the pick-list GetAnimationToPlay draws from). Params: animationId = animation resource id, data = entry config value. Use in AIEVENT_CREATE before playing custom animations.

name: AIFunction_SendResponse
note: Sends the AI's RESPONSE to the current event (used for ALERT_RESPONSE chains so buddy AIs react too). Takes no args. Call inside alert handlers.

name: Define_AmmoType
note: Defines an AMMO TYPE inside an ammo definition block of a .qsc/.cfg script (515-byte parser body; igi.exe embeds str 'DefineAmmoType'). Args follow the Define-ammo grammar (name, damage, range, clip...) - not fully mapped, treat as parser-internal. Do NOT call outside its define block.

name: Define_Mission
note: Defines a MISSION entry during mission-list parsing (480-byte parser). Called by the engine's mission definition grammar; do NOT call from gameplay scripts.

name: LevelFlow_GetBreakCutSceneKey
note: RETURNS the key code currently bound to 'skip/break cutscene'. Takes no args. Use in cutscene player loops to detect the skip key press.

name: LevelFlow_LevelFailed
note: Signals that the level FAILED - triggers the retail failure flow (fail sound, restart/quit menu). Takes no args. Call when your scripted objective fails.

name: LevelFlow_IsCountryUSA
note: RETURNS 1 if the running build is a USA country build, 0 otherwise (affects censorship/content paths like blood). Takes no args. Check before enabling content that country builds gate.

name: Script_SetWarningLevel
note: Sets how loudly the script system reports warnings while parsing/running (igi.exe embeds its name WITH leading underscore: '_Script_SetWarningLevel'). Param: level = warning verbosity threshold. Use at the top of scripts you want silenced or extra-chatty.

name: Break_Script
note: Breaks/aborts the currently-executing script at this point (70-byte function). Takes no args. Use as an early-exit inside .qsc scripts.

name: Define_MagicObj
note: Defines a MAGIC OBJECT type during magicobj definition parsing (pairs with the MAGICOBJ\ folder data). Parser-context only.

name: Create_TerrainTileMap
note: Creates the TERRAIN TILE MAP for a level during level load (113-byte function). Engine-internal: called by the terrain loader, not meant for gameplay scripts.

name: Define_Group
note: Defines a GROUP entry (sound-group/entity grouping) during definition parsing. Parser-context only.

name: Define_Sound
note: Defines a SOUND entry (file + attenuation params) inside sound definition blocks - OpenIGI reimplements it as SoundDefinitionRegistry.Define(SoundDefinitionKind.Sound). Call only from sound .qsc define blocks.

name: Define_Graph
note: Defines a GRAPH (sound/graph transition graph) entry inside definition blocks - OpenIGI maps it to SoundDefinitionKind.Graph. Parser-context only.

name: Define_TriggerOnce
note: Defines a fire-once TRIGGER entry inside definition blocks - OpenIGI maps it to SoundDefinitionKind.TriggerOnce. Parser-context only.

name: Task_New
note: Instantiates a new game task from a declared type (731-byte factory; OpenIGI registers Task_New reading the type name then declared params). Call inside task blocks after Task_DeclareParameters; argc unknown (parser context).

name: Task_DeclareParameters
note: Declares the parameter list of the task currently being defined inside a .qsc task block (OpenIGI TaskScriptCommands implements it reading a type name + parameter names). Call as FIRST statement of a task definition; argc unknown (parser context).

name: AIFunction_GetAlarmTriggerID
note: RETURNS the id of the alarm trigger bound to this AI (see AIFunction_SetAlarmTriggerID). Takes no args. Use in handlers to check which alarm applies.

name: AIFunction_GetAlarmControlID
note: RETURNS the bound alarm-control id. Takes no args.

name: AIFunction_GetAlarmAccess
note: RETURNS the current AIALARMACCESS mode: BEFORECOMBAT=0, AFTERCOMBAT=1. Takes no args.

name: AIFunction_GetGunnerID
note: RETURNS this AI's assigned gunner slot id. Takes no args.

name: AIFunction_GetAlarmControlStatus
note: RETURNS the status/state of the bound alarm control (raised/used state as tracked by the engine). Takes no args.

name: AIFunction_GetGunnerStatus
note: RETURNS the status of this AI's gunner post (manned/state value). Takes no args.

name: AIFunction_GetScriptIntegerValue
note: READS an AI-script integer variable written by AIFunction_SetScriptIntegerValue. Param: varId = variable index. RETURNS the integer.

name: AIFunction_GetCurrentEventType
note: RETURNS the AIEVENT_* value currently being handled - the backbone of every AI script's if/else chain. Enum: CREATE=0, DELETE=1, DEAD=2, ANIMATION=3, IDLE=4, ALERT=5, ALERT_RESPONSE=6, COMBAT=7, ALARMON=8, ALARMOFF=9, WALK=10, GROUNDIMPACT=11, DOOR=12, FENCE=13, LADDER=14, TAKINGDAMAGE=15, GUNSHOT=16, GRENADETHROWN=17, GRENADELAND=18, FLASHBANG=19, GUNSHOTMISS=20, EXPLOSION=21, ENEMYDETECTION=22, FRIENDLYDETECTION=23. Takes no args.

name: AIFunction_IsEventBehind
note: RETURNS non-zero if the current event came from BEHIND the AI (direction test used for reaction animations). Takes no script args per retail table (engine reads an internal slot via ebp+8). Use in alert/detection handlers.

name: AIFunction_GetAnimationToPlay
note: RETURNS which animation entry the engine decided to play for the current event/action (useful to log or override reactions). Per retail table takes no script args; machine code also touches an [ebp+8] slot (internal context).

name: Config_GraphicOptionsSetGamma
note: Sets and immediately applies gamma to the active profile (also feeds the live lighting math through the profile record +0x220). Param: gamma = float (retail default 1.0). Use in video-options screen script or your own gamma slider.

name: AIFunction_GetScriptRealValue
note: READS an AI-script real (float) variable. Param: varId = variable index. RETURNS the float.

name: AIFunction_GetRandomValue
note: RETURNS a random value below 'max' (returns Real per retail table). Param: max = upper bound. Use for randomized behaviour delays/targets in AI scripts.

name: AIFunction_GetEventDistance
note: RETURNS the DISTANCE to the source of the current event (Real). Takes no args. Use inside event handlers e.g. 'if gunshot closer than X then investigate'.

name: AIFunction_GetAlarmTriggerDistance
note: RETURNS the distance between this AI and its bound ALARM TRIGGER (Real). Takes no args. Use to decide running vs fighting for the alarm.

name: App_ContextSetDebugged
note: Sets the app-level DEBUGGED flag (global 0x5C8BF8). Param: state = 1 mark debugger attached/debug mode, 0 clear. BlankName's IGIPatch calls this by name. Use to toggle engine debug paths.

name: App_ContextSetDebugtextState
note: Toggles on-screen DEBUG TEXT output (global 0x5C8BF4). Param: state = 1 show engine debug text, 0 hide. Handy while reverse-engineering other systems.

name: App_ContextSetLightmapsUsed
note: Enables/disables OBJECT lightmaps globally (global 0x5C8BE4) - the verified retail lightmap setter. Param: used = 1 use object lightmaps, 0 flat-lit. Use for graphics enhancers (this is what IGIPatch's lightmap toggles call).

name: App_ContextSetTerrainLightmapsUsed
note: Enables/disables TERRAIN lightmaps globally (global 0x5C8BE8). Param: used = 1 lit terrain, 0 unlit. Pair with AppContext_SetLightmapsUsed for full lighting control.

name: Config_GetActiveGraphicOptions
note: Returns a pointer to the ACTIVE PROFILE's graphic-options record inside the global config array. The record base is 0xBC2394 + 0xD14 * activeProfileIndex (verified in igi.exe). Useful for reading/writing raw graphic fields directly (gamma sits at record+0x220).

name: Display_GetActiveMode
note: RETURNS pointer to the ACTIVE display-mode struct (global 0xC28B40): width/height/depth fields live at +0x4/+0x8/+0x10 per Display_SetMode comparisons. Takes no args. Read current resolution from here.

name: Display_SetBackgroundColourFn
signature: void Display_SetBackgroundColourFn(int8_t r, int8_t g, int8_t b)
note: Sets the 3D-view BACKGROUND COLOUR (clear colour) - masks each arg to a byte into globals 0xBCADF0/R,G,B. Params: r,g,b = 0-255 colour channels. Use for custom sky/clear colour effects.

name: Display_SetMode
note: Switches the DISPLAY MODE at runtime: validates mode fields vs current (0xC28B44...), repositions/resizes the window (GetSystemMetrics), copies the mode into the active-mode struct. Param: modeStruct = pointer to a display-mode struct (same layout Display_GetActiveMode returns). RETURNS 0 on failure, non-zero on success.

name: Picture_GetHeight
note: RETURNS the HEIGHT in pixels of a loaded picture/surface. Param: picture = picture pointer. Thin thunk to fcn.004B7E00.

name: Picture_GetWidth
note: RETURNS the WIDTH in pixels of a loaded picture/surface. Param: picture = pointer from a picture-load call. Thin thunk to fcn.004B7DF0 (byte-verified).

name: Qsprite_Register4Az
note: Registers a QUAD-SPRITE with full transform data: 14 args, float parameters scaled by constant 0x534AB0, writes sprite tables 0xA84A50/0xA84A58 (verified). Low-level renderer API - map arg layout from callers before use.

name: Transcontext_SetActiveTransContext
note: Installs a TRANSFORM CONTEXT as active: copies 0x2A dwords from ctx into global 0xBCAAE0 and bumps state counters at 0x6E5BB0/B4. Param: ctx = transform-context struct (IGIPatch uses this around custom rendering). Use when injecting your own render passes.

name: QHash_ValueSet
signature: void QHash_ValueSet(int* table, char* key, int value)
note: Sets a value in a QHash hash-table (8-byte thunk into the hash engine at 0x4B0D90 family). Pass the table ptr, key string and integer value. Restored after accidental loss during batch rewrite - address pass1-verified.

name: QHash_ValueGet
note: Gets a value from a QHash hash-table (6-byte getter thunk). Pass table ptr + key string, RETURNS the stored integer. Restored after accidental loss - address pass1-verified.

name: DEBUG_KEYSENABLEINVALID
note: TOMBSTONE - DO NOT INVOKE. The retail debug-keys native address is UNKNOWN. The old value 0x0041502 lies outside .text (0x401000-0x532510) and would crash on invoke; no verified replacement found in igi.exe (unknown > fabricated per RE.md). This entry exists only so JSON consumers see the warning instead of silently missing the key.

name: QScript_Cleanup
note: Cleans up/frees a parsed .qsc script structure (pass1: 5 calls, valid exit). Param: script = pointer to the loaded script object. Call when done with a script loaded via the Qvm/Qsc loaders to release its memory.

name: Human_FindNextCamera
note: Debug camera cycler: advances to the next camera/view target attached to the human player (decompiled body polls input keys). Param: human = human-player pointer. Pass1-verified function start; restored - it existed only in the Natives.hpp enum and was never serialized to JSON.

name: CutScene_TaskCreate
note: CREATES the CutScene task during level load: allocates 632-byte "CutScene" object via class factory 0x401900, attaches vtable 0x4F4EE0 + update cb 0x4F51D0, registers TASKTYPE_CUTSCENE (@0x4F4EB8). TO DELETE CUTSCENES: early-return from this function so no CutScene task is ever instantiated - flow continues without them. note: Returns *(void**)(Game_GetContext()+0x20), the script/task context initialized during game setup. Level_Start passes it through the script-data wrapper; the main-menu path pushes its return value as Menu_Manager's first argument.

name: Flow_SetState
note: Stores a pending flow state in game-context field +0x2C. The main loop consumes it, copies it to +0x28, clears the pending field, and dispatches state IDs 1 through 8. Flow_RequestEvent reaches this setter after converting its event ID.

name: Frames_GetUpdateCounter
note: Returns the update-loop counter at game-context field +0x34. Frames_Set resets it and the retail main loop increments it once per simulation/update pass; gameplay timeout code compares against this value.

name: Frames_GetTaskCounter
note: Returns the second task/processing counter at game-context field +0x38. Frames_Set resets it and the retail main loop increments it during the second processing pass.

name: Game_TimingBegin
note: Begins a nested timing interval: starts the retail timer when the timing depth is zero, then increments the depth counter. Level_Start and Game_Restart bracket their load work with this helper and Game_TimingEnd.

name: Game_TimingEnd
note: Ends a nested timing interval: decrements the depth counter and, at zero, adds elapsed timer ticks to game-context field +0x50 and clears the interval start timestamp.
